title: Add visual customer receivable evidence report designer
description: User scene: from the customer sales-invoice register, choose allowed invoice and receipt evidence fields, bounded filters and preview the arithmetic remaining evidence, including unknown states. Reuse only ERP-117's scoped report endpoint; a saved or guessed field key cannot bypass its catalog. Authorization, empty rows and network errors are visible without leaking data. Existing request audit covers preview calls. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, database writes, migration, real database execution, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify with Node UI logic tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Customer sales-invoice register opens a visual field/filter chooser populated by ERP-117 catalog, with customer/date/currency/allocation filters and no free-form SQL.
Preview renders only selected returned columns and labels known remaining versus unknown or over-allocated evidence; authorization, empty and network failures are safe and visible.
Automated UI logic tests cover field allowlist, request bounds, safe cell rendering and failure states; document the user workflow and run Node syntax/test checks plus safe build/test.
